tech_stack.architecture: Monolithic server-rendered web application on IIS 7 / Windows Server 2008

findings.title: No Documented API Interface
findings.description: The application does not expose a documented REST, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI interface. It is a legacy ColdFusion 8 server-rendered web application with two .cfm pages accessed via browser HTTP requests. Integration would require direct database access or UI automation.
findings.gap: No API layer exists. The only integration surface is server-rendered HTML pages or direct SQL Server database access.
findings.recommendation: Define a REST API layer with OpenAPI documentation for document search and download functionality.

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL schema, or Smithy model files exist. The application has no formal API to document.
findings.gap: No machine-readable specification for agent tool generation.
findings.recommendation: Create an OpenAPI specification as part of API modernization.

findings.title: No Structured Error Responses
findings.description: ColdFusion 8 returns default HTML error pages on failure. No structured error codes, no machine-readable error bodies, no retryable/terminal classification.
findings.gap: Agents cannot distinguish error types. All failures appear as HTML error pages.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured JSON error responses with error codes, messages, and retryable classification.

findings.title: No Idempotent Write Operations
findings.description: Write operations have no idempotency controls. No idempotency keys, no unique constraints, no deduplication logic.
findings.gap: No idempotency key support. Duplicate agent calls would create duplicate records.
findings.recommendation: Add idempotency key support to all write endpoints with unique constraint enforcement.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no idempotency controls exist.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The system exposes write operations (document uploads) with no idempotency mechanism. Agent retries would duplicate records.

findings.title: HTML Response Format Only
findings.description: Responses are HTML (server-rendered pages) and application/octet-stream for file downloads. No JSON or structured data format.
findings.gap: Not machine-parseable without HTML scraping.
findings.recommendation: Modernize to JSON API responses.

findings.title: No Asynchronous Operation Support
findings.description: No async patterns exist. File downloads served synchronously. No background job framework, no polling endpoints, no webhook callbacks.
findings.gap: Large file downloads could timeout for agent callers with no async fallback.
findings.recommendation: Implement async download patterns (signed URLs, job-based retrieval) for large files.

findings.title: No Event Emission for State Changes
findings.description: No event emission capability. No webhooks, SNS, EventBridge, SQS, Kafka, or CDC pipelines.
findings.gap: Agents cannot react to state changes proactively. Polling is the only option.
findings.recommendation: Consider EventBridge integration for document lifecycle events.

findings.title: No Rate Limit Documentation or Headers
findings.description: No rate limit documentation or headers. No X-RateLimit-Remaining, no Retry-After headers, no API Gateway usage plans.
findings.gap: Agents have no visibility into rate limits and cannot self-throttle.
findings.recommendation: Implement rate limit headers when API layer is built.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: The application uses only session-based browser authentication. No OAuth2 client credentials, no API key authentication, no mTLS, no service accounts.
findings.gap: No machine identity mechanism. Agents cannot authenticate without browser-based session cookies.
findings.recommendation: Implement API key or OAuth2 client credentials flow for machine-to-machine authentication.

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions
findings.description: Binary auth check (logged in or not). No role differentiation, no resource-level permissions, no action-level scoping.
findings.gap: All authenticated users have identical access. No mechanism to scope down agent access.
findings.recommendation: Implement role-based access control with scoped permissions per resource type and action.

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: No action-level authorization. Single session check is the only gate. Cannot enforce read-but-not-delete.
findings.gap: Cannot enforce differential access by action type.
findings.recommendation: Implement RBAC or ABAC with per-action permission checks.

findings.title: No Identity Propagation or Delegation
findings.description: No identity propagation mechanism. Session-only, no JWT, no token exchange, no on-behalf-of flows.
findings.gap: Cannot distinguish agent-as-self vs agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2/JWT with on-behalf-of token exchange support.

findings.title: Insecure Credential Management
findings.description: Datasource password is 'cfadmin' documented in README. No secrets management system. No rotation capability.
findings.gap: Hardcoded/weak credentials with no secure management or rotation.
findings.recommendation: Migrate credentials to AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation. Remove from README.

findings.title: No Immutable Audit Logging
findings.description: No audit logging of any kind. No CloudTrail, no application-level logging, no immutable storage. The application does not log who performed what action.
findings.gap: No audit trail. Cannot prove compliance or conduct forensics.
findings.recommendation: Implement immutable audit logging with principal attribution stored in append-only storage.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no audit logging exists.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write-enabled agent operations require immutable audit trails for compliance. No logging of any kind exists.

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension Mechanism
findings.description: No mechanism to suspend or revoke individual agent identities. Session invalidation is the only option.
findings.gap: Cannot isolate a misbehaving agent without affecting all users.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-agent API key management with instant revocation capability.

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback
findings.description: No compensation or rollback mechanisms. No sagas, no undo endpoints, no transactional boundaries. Write operations are immediate and irreversible.
findings.gap: Failed multi-step operations leave partial state with no recovery mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Implement transactional boundaries with rollback support for write operations.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no rollback/compensation exists.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write-enabled agents executing multi-step workflows need rollback. No compensation logic exists anywhere in the application.

findings.title: State Not Queryable via API
findings.description: State queryable only through HTML search interface. No machine-readable state query API exists.
findings.gap: State inspection requires HTML parsing. No dedicated state-query endpoints.
findings.recommendation: Expose document state via REST endpoints with full metadata.

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No concurrency controls. No optimistic locking, no version fields, no ETags, no conflict resolution logic.
findings.gap: Multiple concurrent agent instances could create race conditions on document records.
findings.recommendation: Add version fields and implement optimistic locking with conflict detection.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting or Throttling
findings.description: No rate limiting at any layer. No API Gateway throttling, no WAF, no application middleware.
findings.gap: A runaway agent loop could overwhelm the single-instance application.
findings.recommendation: Deploy API Gateway or WAF with rate limiting in front of the application.

findings.title: No Blast Radius or Transaction Limits
findings.description: No transaction limits. Unbounded query results, no per-session caps, no maximum records per operation.
findings.gap: Agent errors could affect unlimited records with no safeguards.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-caller transaction limits.

findings.title: No Draft/Pending State
findings.description: No draft or pending state concept. Documents are immediately available upon upload with no review step.
findings.gap: No mechanism for agent-proposed changes with human review before committing.
findings.recommendation: Add a status field (DRAFT/PENDING/PUBLISHED) to the documents table.

findings.title: No Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No approval gate mechanism. All operations execute immediately with no configurable approval steps.
findings.gap: Cannot require human approval for high-risk agent operations.
findings.recommendation: Implement approval workflow endpoints for high-risk operations.

findings.title: No Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No sandbox or staging environment. Single EC2 instance is the only runtime.
findings.gap: No safe environment to test agent behavior without risk to live systems.
findings.recommendation: Create a staging environment with synthetic document data for agent testing.

findings.title: No Sensitive Data Access Differentiation
findings.description: User data present (uploaded_by, session.fullname, session.userid). No access control differentiation — all authenticated users see all data identically.
findings.gap: No differentiated access for sensitive vs non-sensitive data. Single permission grants access to everything.
findings.recommendation: Implement role-based field filtering and access control differentiation in API responses.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to RISK-SAFETY: Stage A = Yes (user-specific data present). B1 = RISK-SAFETY (limited sensitive fields in HTML, no formal API). B2 = RISK-SAFETY (no access differentiation). Overall = RISK-SAFETY.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: B1 evaluates as RISK-SAFETY because while user identity fields are displayed, there is no formal API and the exposure is limited to document metadata. B2 fires because no access control differentiation exists.

b1.reasoning: User identity fields (uploaded_by, session.fullname) displayed in HTML output. No formal API with scoped response filtering.

b2.reasoning: Single binary auth check. No differentiation between sensitive and non-sensitive data access.

b3.reasoning: No formal data classification metadata, tags, or PII detection tooling.

findings.title: Undefined Data Residency Posture
findings.description: Data residency posture is undefined. Documents stored on local EC2 disk with no documented region or jurisdiction constraints.
findings.gap: No residency policy documented. Unknown whether stored documents are subject to regulatory requirements.
findings.recommendation: Audit stored documents for regulatory classification. Document data residency requirements.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to RISK-SAFETY: agent_scope=write-enabled but no confirmed regulatory mandate. Residency posture undefined rather than violated.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: No explicit data residency requirements documented. Documents stored on EC2 local disk but no regulatory framework (GDPR, LGPD, HIPAA) referenced. Risk exists but is unconfirmed, so RISK-SAFETY rather than BLOCKER.

findings.title: No Pagination or Selective Query Support
findings.description: Search query returns all matching results with no pagination, no limit/offset, no cursor. Unbounded result sets.
findings.gap: No pagination, no result size limits. Large result sets exhaust agent context windows.
findings.recommendation: Implement pagination with configurable page size and cursor-based navigation.

findings.title: No Input Validation — SQL Injection Vulnerable
findings.description: No input validation. SQL injection via string concatenation in both .cfm files. No parameterized queries, no sanitization, no type checking.
findings.gap: Malformed/malicious inputs accepted without rejection. Critical security vulnerability.
findings.recommendation: Implement cfqueryparam for parameterized queries immediately. Add input validation with structured error responses.

findings.title: Limited Temporal Metadata
findings.description: Only uploaded_on field exists. No updated_at, no freshness signaling, no timezone handling.
findings.gap: Cannot determine data freshness or detect stale data.
findings.recommendation: Add updated_at timestamps with UTC storage and freshness signaling headers.

findings.title: No PII Redaction in Logs
findings.description: No PII redaction. No structured logging. User data (session.fullname, uploaded_by) flows unprotected. ColdFusion 8 error pages expose variable values.
findings.gap: No log scrubbing or PII masking. User data could leak into logs.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured logging with PII redaction before any agent integration.

findings.title: No Data Quality Awareness
findings.description: No data quality metrics, dashboards, profiling, or completeness monitoring for the documents dataset.
findings.gap: Agents may act on incomplete or stale data without awareness.
findings.recommendation: Implement data quality monitoring (null rates, completeness) for the documents table.

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or API Contracts
findings.description: No schema versioning, no API contracts, no breaking change detection, no contract tests.
findings.gap: No versioning strategy. Changes could break agent integrations silently.
findings.recommendation: Implement API versioning with breaking change detection in CI.

findings.title: Semantically Meaningful Field Names
findings.description: Field names are semantically meaningful and human-readable: doc_id, title, category, uploaded_by, uploaded_on, filename. Positive signal.
findings.gap: None — positive signal for agent integration.
findings.recommendation: Maintain this naming convention in modernization.

findings.title: No Data Catalog or Metadata Layer
findings.description: No data catalog or metadata layer. Schema knowledge exists only implicitly in SQL queries.
findings.gap: No discoverable metadata about what data the system holds.
findings.recommendation: Document the data model and consider a lightweight data catalog.

findings.title: No Distributed Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No tracing, no structured logging, no correlation IDs. No OpenTelemetry, no X-Ray, no JSON logging.
findings.gap: Agent-initiated requests are completely undebuggable.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured JSON logging with correlation IDs and integrate with X-Ray or OpenTelemetry.

findings.title: No Alerting on Error Rates or Latency
findings.description: No alerting configuration. No CloudWatch alarms, no anomaly detection, no PagerDuty/OpsGenie integration.
findings.gap: No automated detection of degraded service affecting agents.
findings.recommendation: Implement CloudWatch alarms for error rates, latency, and availability.

findings.title: No Infrastructure as Code
findings.description: No IaC. Manually configured EC2 with manual deployment via file copy. No Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK.
findings.gap: No IaC, no peer review of infrastructure changes, no drift detection.
findings.recommendation: Define infrastructure as code with peer review and drift detection.

findings.title: No CI/CD or Contract Testing
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline. Manual file copy deployment. No automated testing, no contract testing, no breaking change detection.
findings.gap: No CI/CD, no automated testing, no breaking change detection.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline with automated API contract testing.

findings.title: No Rollback Capability
findings.description: No rollback capability. Manual file copy is the only deployment method. No blue/green, no CodeDeploy, no canary.
findings.gap: No automated rollback. Recovery from bad deployments is manual.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated deployment with rollback capability.

findings.title: No API Test Coverage
findings.description: No automated tests of any kind. Zero test files in repository.
findings.gap: No test coverage. Changes cannot be validated automatically.
findings.recommendation: Implement API test suite as part of modernization.

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest
findings.description: No encryption at rest. Local disk storage unencrypted. SQL Server 2005 does not support TDE. No KMS keys.
findings.gap: Data at rest is unencrypted — both files on disk and database contents.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to encrypted storage (S3 with SSE-KMS, RDS with encryption enabled).

evaluations.title: Circuit Breakers and Resilience
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — service does not call other services or external APIs.

evaluations.title: Graceful Degradation Signaling
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no P0 priority assigned and not identified as critical path.

evaluations.title: Business Outcome Metrics
evaluations.reason: Informational-absence suppression: system emits no metrics or telemetry of any kind — no observability surface to assess. No finding emitted.

items.summary: Resolve all BLOCKERs and critical RISK-SAFETY findings. Focus on establishing an API layer, machine identity, audit logging, and foundational safety controls.
Address RISK-QUALITY findings that improve agent effectiveness. Implement observability, CI/CD, encryption, and API quality improvements.
Address informational findings and remaining quality improvements. Implement event emission, data quality monitoring, and comprehensive test coverage.

recommended_actions.action: Build REST API layer with OpenAPI specification
recommended_actions.rationale: The application has no API — this is the fundamental BLOCKER. All other improvements depend on having a callable API surface.

recommended_actions.action: Implement machine identity and OAuth2/JWT authentication
recommended_actions.rationale: Agents cannot authenticate. Machine identity must be established before any agent integration is possible.

recommended_actions.action: Deploy immutable audit logging with CloudTrail and S3 Object Lock
recommended_actions.rationale: Write-enabled agent operations require immutable audit trails for compliance and forensics.

recommended_actions.action: Implement idempotency keys and transaction rollback
recommended_actions.rationale: Agent retries and multi-step workflows require idempotent operations and compensation mechanisms.

recommended_actions.action: Migrate credentials to AWS Secrets Manager
recommended_actions.rationale: Hardcoded weak credentials create immediate security risk. Quick remediation.

recommended_actions.action: Deploy API Gateway with rate limiting and WAF
recommended_actions.rationale: Protects the single-instance application from agent traffic storms.

recommended_actions.action: Fix SQL injection and implement input validation
recommended_actions.rationale: Critical security vulnerability. Fix with cfqueryparam immediately regardless of agent readiness.
